note: Only the restored Liv.52 authorized local export record was retrieved/staged. No remote bulk catalogue was retrieved because authorized WooCommerce credentials are absent.

qa_incident.description: During development, a polluted DB_DATABASE shell env caused PHPUnit RefreshDatabase to wipe database/qa.sqlite. Schema was rebuilt with migrate and Liv.52 was re-staged from the known prior source identity via an authorized local JSON export. No Neon/production data was touched.

next_action_required: Provide CATALOGUE_WC_CONSUMER_KEY and CATALOGUE_WC_CONSUMER_SECRET with read access to /wp-json/wc/v3/products, or place a full official product export JSON under storage/app/catalogue-import/exports/, then run: php artisan catalogue:bulk-ingest --source=woocommerce --run=2026-bulk-001 --limit=50
